question: Which two categories of age group are considered in Khelo India Youth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Under 17 and Under 21.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Youth Games considers two categories of age groups: Under 17 and Under 21.**
 
• The games are organized by the** Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in India.**
 
• The main objective of the games is to promote sports and fitness among youth in India.
 
• The games also provide a platform for young athletes to showcase their talent and compete at the national level.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games will be held at eight locations. More than 8 thousand 500 athletes and sportspersons are expected to participate in the sporting event.
 
• **Khelo India Youth Games** was started **in 2016 and provided a very effective platform for the youth of the country to showcase their performance and talents in sports.**
 
• Minister Anurag Thakur said that Madhya Pradesh is now showing its excellence in every sector and the State Chief Minister has improved the infrastructure of sports and built up a big infrastructure of shooting and water sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG), **formerly Khelo India School Games (KISG), are the annual national-level multidisciplinary grassroots games in India held in January or February for two categories, namely under-17-year-old school students and under-21 college students.
 
• Every year best 1,000 kids will be given an annual scholarship of ₹5 lakh (US$6,300) for 8 years to prepare them for the international sporting events
